name: Conventional Deadlift
cues: Stand with the bar over your midfoot and grip just outside your legs
Pull the slack out and brace with a flat back before the bar moves
Squeeze your armpits to keep the bar against your legs
Push the floor away, then drive your hips through
Hinge first on the way down, then bend your knees once the bar passes them

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-08 (delegated to the lead). Earlier: v1.x fix 2026-10-08, re-review. Floor start recalibrated: the bar rests against the shins with the shoulders about 4 cm ahead of it, instead of the arms resting on the legs (the forearms met the thighs first and held the knees back). Knee 59 -> 64, ankle dorsiflexion 3.5 -> 8, knees now over the bar; grip 1.2 -> 1.35 so the knees clear the arms. Hip flexion stays about 120 and the trunk about 18 deg above horizontal: with bar over midfoot and straight arms that is set by this figure's arm length (both skeptics agree).
